Nora (Sales): Quick: HelixCare wants a short POC (10 days) focused on front-desk automation. Day 0 tomorrow 2pm PT. Need to align success criteria, data handling, and a minimal eval set.
Ethan - Solutions: I'll bring 25 seed prompts + 10 adversarial cases. Suggest success metrics: routing accuracy >= 90%, avg response time < 600ms.
Priya Patel: Security asks: PHI? They said limited PHI. Requesting KMS, audit logs, and DPA. Who owns legal touchpoint?
Gabe Eng: Infra needs expected concurrency and avg token length. If PHI, recommend Dedicated. Also propose canary fallback to quantized model.
Legal Bot: I'll queue DPA template; need Helix legal contact and PHI confirmation to advise on BAA.
Nora (Sales): Action list: Helix to send stakeholder list + 50 sample inputs; Ethan to upload prompts; Gabe to draft runbook snippet; Priya to send security factsheet. We'll confirm owners in the call.
Ethan - Solutions: I'll post the curl smoke test and seed prompts after the call.
Priya Patel: Noted. Will prepare security summary within 24h.
Gabe Eng: I'll size a 1-GPU dedicated pool for pilot and note autoscale thresholds.
Nora (Sales): Great. See you at 2pm PT. Ping me for urgent updates. :thumbsup:
